findings.finding: [native] The ARIA snapshot marks Cancel as focused when the confirmation opens, but Cancel shows no ring. It only has its 1 px button.border, and no focusBorder pixel appears at the +2 offset around it. A native workbench dialog draws a 1 px focusBorder ring on its focused button, and DS-FOCUS-3 says the main panel draws rings after a click in both looks, so nothing shows where keyboard focus is. | [states] Keyboard focus sits on the dialog's Cancel button (the aria snapshot marks it [focused]), but the capture draws no 1 px focusBorder ring at offset +2 around it. A text button in the main panel should show its focus ring after a click as well as after a key, so nothing on the screen shows where focus is.
